name: Data size converter
summary: Convert bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB and KiB, MiB, GiB
author: friday-core
description: Converts data sizes between bytes, decimal units (KB, MB, GB, TB, in thousands) and binary units (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, in 1024s), and explains why a 500 GB drive shows about 465 GB in Windows.
